definition: rolling a ball to knock over pins
description: In a retro bowling alley with teal walls, red panels and neon lights, a young woman with a long blonde braid, in a red cropped jacket and cream trousers, throws both arms up in celebration as her ball crashes into the white pins at the end of the shiny wooden lane and knocks them down. In the foreground another person's arm points down the lane. Then she lowers her arms, turns around and looks back with an open mouth and a surprised smile.

taps.phrase: to raise both arms in triumph

de.answer: Sie reißt triumphierend beide Arme hoch.
